    level="1"

>
[Branch of the Great Sugi](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3132)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 73

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in one hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This large tree branch is alive, despite having been harvested from the sugi tree it once belonged to. This long, flexible, and limber branch is a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [whip](/Weapons.aspx?ID=404)_. When used to Strike, the branch snaps with the sound of a cracking whip but fills the air surrounding the point of impact with the pleasant scent of freshly cut cedar and a sprinkling of fallen leaves on the ground. 

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You place the _branch of the great sugi_ on the corpse of an evil creature, then cause the branch to suddenly grow into a sugi tree, up to 25 feet tall with a 2-foot-wide trunk. As it grows, it emits a pulse of soothing energy, restoring 3d8+8 Hit Points to all creatures in a 10-foot burst. A character can [Climb ](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374)the tree with a successful DC 10 Athletics check, and its branches effortlessly support the weight of any Medium or smaller creature. The sugi tree reverts to its whip form after 1 hour unless you transform it back before then. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You transform the _branch of the great sugi_ from its tree form back into its whip form.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
